description:
Position Summary


We are seeking a Data Integration Engineer to join our growing technology team and take ownership of critical data integrations between key business platforms such as CRM and ERP systems. This role will focus on designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable integration data pipelines that ensure accurate and timely synchronization of business data across systems.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building and supporting integrations between platforms such as Salesforce and NetSuite, leveraging modern integration tools, like Boomi, and custom logic where needed. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to ensure end-to-end data accuracy and reliability across the enterprise.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

·         Research, analyze, design, build, and maintain data integration workﬂows and pipelines connecting CRM, ERP, and related business systems (e.g., Salesforce < > NetSuite).

·         Develop and enhance real-time and batch integrations using APIs, middleware (e.g., Boomi), and custom code to automate the exchange of customer, order, subscription, and asset data.

·         Monitor and support production integrations by setting up and maintaining robust logging, monitoring, and alerting to proactively detect and resolve issues.

·         Troubleshoot and resolve data synchronization issues, including mismatches, latency, or failed transactions, ensuring consistent and accurate data ﬂow between systems.

·         Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Sales Operations, Finance, Engineering) to gather integration requirements, deﬁne data mapping rules, and document workﬂows.

·         Implement and maintain transformation logic, mappings, and business rules to ensure alignment between CRM and ERP data models, including handling custom ﬁelds and complex object hierarchies.

·         Maintain existing and build new documentation for all integration processes, data mappings, and operational procedures.

·         Partner with data engineering and architecture teams to ensure integrated data supports analytics and reporting needs.

·         Stay current with industry trends, integration best practices, and emerging technologies that can improve performance, reliability, or maintainability.

Required Skills and Experience

·         5+ years of experience in data integration, data engineering, or systems integration roles.

·         Hands-on experience integrating Salesforce and NetSuite systems, with a solid understanding of their data structures, APIs and query languages (SOQL, SuiteQL).

·         Experience with accounting systems, subscription models or order management workﬂows and asset lifecycle synchronization between business systems.

·         Proﬁciency in REST/SOAP APIs, including authentication, pagination, and batch processing.

·         Experience with integration/middleware platforms in particular Boomi AtomSphere and its process design, deployment, and management.

·         Background in scripting languages for scripting custom connectors or transformations and an ability to generate custom scripting to handle complex business logic.

·         Strong SQL skills for querying, validating, and reconciling data, and understanding of relational database concepts.

·         Familiarity with data transformation and mapping between systems, including custom objects and calculated ﬁelds.

·         Experience with cloud-based environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their integration or automation capabilities.

·         Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset for identifying issues before they impact users.

·         Understanding of data governance, security, and privacy best practices related to business system integrations.

·         Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms and collaborate eﬀectively across teams.

·         Ability to speak ﬂuent English.
